comparison_scope.method: Authenticate both freezes, saved analyses/reviews and every compared raw/joint capture. Compare ordered IDs/sourceSHA/token coordinates, binary32 heads and authoritative statuses/entire canonical IR. Compare saved score totals; reconstruct N8 per-ID fullIR sets from its saved paired changes against the verified common initial outputs. No gold/selector/model rescoring.

composition_proposal.compute_budget: Each component received 32 updates; composition would carry 64 component updates, not establish equal 32-update/equal-FLOPs performance against either single pilot.
composition_proposal.decoded_output_caveat: Component-logit preservation does not preserve full greedy/joint outputs. Temporal presence changes active span constraints, nonoverlap, abstention and joint search; actor changes can interact with temporal candidates and tie guards.
composition_proposal.feasibility: The disjoint trained readouts can in principle coexist above one authenticated frozen split34 feature base, preserving their component logits. This is a source-based inference, not a measured combined result.
composition_proposal.if_chosen: Freeze a separate bounded composition protocol, authenticate both component states, qualify source/controls, prove component/protected parity and freeze predictions before parent-only scoring. Report per-ID gains/losses and known temporal regressions; no combined score is claimed.
composition_proposal.known_regressions: Retaining N7 temporal logits also retains its observed two old_authored_eval presence mistakes. Actor boundaries do not directly repair modality/presence or missing other-role candidates.
composition_proposal.required_component_preservation: Retain full6/full8 projection geometry, contiguous mean/attention blocks, masks and arithmetic association. Require actual binary32 equality to both saved component captures after implementation; common frozen hashes alone are insufficient.

conclusion: N7 and N8 start from directly verified identical scores and predictions on the same 632 rows. The trained differences reflect disjoint changes: N7 temporal presence and N8 actor boundaries.

explanation.legacy96: Both initial states have 94/96 fullIR. N7 changes temporal presence and recovers native-tuning-calendula-t6-q7-o on both routes, ending 95/96. N8 protects all temporal presence scores and ends 94/96. Both retain all 32 P outcomes; this difference is not an actor or modality change.
explanation.measured_initial_equality: All 632 complete score vectors, source ID/SHA/token scopes and raw/joint status+entire canonical IR match directly, rather than relying on common-parent labels.
explanation.old_authored_eval72: Both initial joint totals are 51/72. N7 introduces temporal-presence false negatives for matched-temporal-authored_eval-exception_duration-0-p-present and -f-present: joint 51→49, while raw 48→47 loses only the P row. N8 protects all presence and retains joint 51/raw 48; its actor exactness gains do not yield fullIR gains on this panel.
explanation.trained_protection: All 632 trained common modality/non-temporal presence/five nonactor boundary components match across branches. N7 actor boundaries equal initial; N8 temporal presence equals initial.

limits: All 464 diagnostic sources and N7fresh72 are exposed engineering diagnostics; no blind generalization claim.
No checkpoint JSON parsing or new model/encoder/optimizer/selector execution; no fused score arrays constructed.
Default promotion remains false, semantic_accuracy is null; statutory8 remain unscored and family/Lake/independent statutory-gold qualifications are absent.
The sealed 135-file HF payload remains unchanged.
metric_definition: Whole canonical IR equality includes modality plus all six roles. Six-role diagnostic maps omit modality only as a decomposition. Raw decoded/joint selected statuses are authoritative; abstentions are nonmatches.

source_architecture.N7: Query plus full8 separate mean/attention projections, returning only temporal presence rows6:8. All boundary/modality/non-temporal presence outputs stay original.
source_architecture.N8: Separate full6 start/end projections, returning only actor row0. All presence/modality and the five nonactor boundary outputs stay original.
source_architecture.feature_context: Both use the same split _features(False) for frozen modality mean pooling and _features(True) for frozen span encodings. N7 attention pools encoded span features; N8 actor projections read those same frozen encodings. Neither learned readout feeds back into features or the other readout.
